_readme: Spark is intentionally on MAINNET, not testnet. Spark's testnet auth service
testing on 2026-08-27 — 'UNAVAILABLE: connection refused' — while the exact same
wdk-wallet-spark config against MAINNET worked correctly. Bitcoin, Ethereum, and
Tron below are all real testnets; Spark is the one exception.
THIS MEANS SPARK TRANSACTIONS IN THIS APP USE REAL VALUE. Do not fund the Spark
account casually, and do not treat this network the same as the other three.
Follow-up: check with the team whether Spark's testnet is expected to come back,
or whether REGTEST is the intended path for local dogfooding — every example in
Spark's own upstream SDK docs (docs.spark.money) uses MAINNET or REGTEST, never
TESTNET, which may mean testnet just isn't well-monitored on their side.
This field is never read by src/config/doctorRuntime.ts (which only looks at
networks/protocols/modules) — it exists purely for anyone opening this file.
